name: insane-search
description: Fallback-only fork of insane-search: steps in only after a normal fetch fails, with no session-wide routing. Public-content reader that reaches public pages, official APIs, and feeds via a Phase 0→3 adaptive access chain (curl_cffi impersonation, mobile/URL transforms, headless-browser fallback). No API keys. Dual-use developer tool; the user is responsible for lawful, authorized use.
